findings.message: effect is created without a reactive owner; nothing will ever dispose it, so it keeps running and holding its subscriptions for the lifetime of the app; the containing function may be a Solid component or an ordinary helper, so its owner context cannot be certified
findings.hint: Create effects inside a component or computation so their owner disposes them. For deliberate module-scope reactivity, wrap the setup in createRoot(dispose => ...) and keep the dispose handle. Use the function through JSX or annotate it with Solid's Component type to establish component ownership; otherwise handle the helper's lifetime explicitly.
